title: The Moon, Through My Telescope, Before Anyone Else

content.question: What colour is the moon when I look at it through the telescope at dusk, and does it look the same as it did before?
content.method: At dusk on the telescope I sat very still, kept my eyes on the moon, and did not let anyone else take a turn. I looked for a long time and compared what I saw with the grey-gold I remembered from my earlier looks.
content.result: Through the telescope the moon looked paler than I expected, a thin cream with a faint warm edge where the light was low, and I am not sure whether the warmth is in the moon or in my own eyes. The silver patches looked cooler. Nothing I saw settles it, so I will keep looking, and I will not tell anyone the answer until I am certain.
